plain: A change or addition made to a law, bill, or constitution

webster.text: An alteration or change for the better; correction of a fault or faults; reformation of life, by quitting vices.

more.text: A word, clause or paragraph, added or proposed to be added to a bill before a legislature.

example.quote: He wished also the plan of the Convention to go forth as an amendment to the articles of Confederation, since under this idea the authority of the Legislatures could ratify it.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 20, 1787
